responses: DBMS stands for Database Management System. It is software that stores and manages data efficiently using tables and relationships between them.
Functions of DBMS include data storage, retrieval, manipulation, data security, concurrency control, and recovery from failures.
The main data models in DBMS are hierarchical, network, relational, and object-oriented models.
An Operating System (OS) is system software that manages computer hardware and software resources and provides services to programs.
A deadlock is a situation in which two or more processes are waiting for each other indefinitely to release resources.
A thread is the smallest unit of CPU execution. It shares the same resources like memory with other threads in a process.
Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) are used to organize data efficiently and solve problems effectively using logic and computation.
A Computer Network is a collection of interconnected devices that communicate and share data through transmission media.
Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) organizes code into objects which combine data and methods for better modularity and reuse.
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the simulation of human intelligence by machines that can learn, reason, and make decisions.
Computer Architecture defines how the components of a computer system are organized and interact, including CPU design, memory, and buses.
